💡 swell | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide users with a highly organized and private browsing experience by isolating different online activities into distinct 'spaces' within a single browser window.
✨ Key Features: • Per-space identity isolation (cookies, storage, history, passwords, extensions, permissions, downloads) • Sidebar tree (favorites, pinned tabs, folders) • Command bar • Tab restore and Cmd+Z for deleted rows
📖 Summary: Swell is a minimal, open-source browser built on the Gecko engine, offering per-space profile isolation. It allows users to maintain separate identities, cookies, history, and extensions for different contexts within a single browser window, enhancing privacy and organization.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ cleanyourtv | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To remove bloatware and ads from Android TV/Google TV home screens, replacing them with a cleaner, more user-friendly interface similar to Apple TV, all managed wirelessly.
✨ Key Features: • Debloat Android TV/Google TV over Wi-Fi • Replace stock launcher with Apple TV-style launcher • No root required • No applications uninstalled • One-line restore option
📖 Summary: CleanYourTV is a Python-based tool that allows users to debloat their Android TV or Google TV devices over Wi-Fi. It replaces the default, ad-filled home screen with a clean, Apple TV-style launcher without requiring root access or uninstalling any applications, and provides a simple restore option.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 screenplink | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: A realistic and engaging dry-fire training and gaming system that uses a standard monitor as the target, allowing users to practice shooting skills in a safe and accessible way.
✨ Key Features: • Laser dry-fire shooting game using a monitor as the target • Webcam-based hit detection and visual feedback (bullet holes) • Multiple drills and targets with scoring • Magazine simulation and empty-fire clicks
📖 Summary: ScreenPlink is a Python-based laser dry-fire shooting game where a webcam tracks laser impacts on a monitor, simulating shooting drills and games. It offers various drills, scoring, and multi-player support, designed for training, entertainment, and commercial use.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 Scrapling | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automated web scraping and data extraction from websites.
✨ Key Features: • Handles single requests to full-scale crawls • Modern web scraping framework • Supports Playwright • AI-powered scraping capabilities • Data extraction
📖 Summary: Scrapling is a Python web scraping framework designed for efficient data extraction from single requests to large-scale crawls. It leverages modern web technologies and offers robust features for handling complex scraping tasks.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 two_claps_open | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Hands-free control of computer actions and applications through simple clap gestures.
✨ Key Features: • Clap detection using audio signal processing (bandpass filtering and peak detection) • Ability to open applications (e.g., Chrome) or execute custom commands upon detecting two claps • Option to activate a voice assistant agent with a double clap • Cross-platform compatibility (with specific setup for Windows)
📖 Summary: This Python repository allows users to trigger actions, such as opening applications or activating voice assistants, by detecting a sequence of two claps. It processes audio input to identify clap patterns and execute predefined commands.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 voicebox | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide users with a powerful, local, and free AI voice studio for cloning, generating, and utilizing voices across various applications and AI agents.
✨ Key Features: • Voice cloning from short audio samples • Speech generation with 23 languages and 8 TTS engines • Global hotkey for dictation into any text field • Voice output for AI agents
📖 Summary: Voicebox is an open-source, local-first AI voice studio that allows users to clone voices, generate speech in multiple languages and TTS engines, and use voice input for AI agents. It offers a comprehensive voice input/output solution that runs entirely on the user's machine, serving as a free alternative to cloud-based services like ElevenLabs.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
